name: פירוק פולינום ממעלה שלישית לגורמים לינאריים – כששורש אחד ידוע (באנגלית)
questiontext: Factorise the expression \[{{CT:0}}\] into the form \[\left(x - a\right)\left(x - b\right) \left(x - c\right)\] given that the expression evaluates to zero when \(x = {{CT:1}}\). The roots are real. [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback: Given that the polynomial {{CT:2}} is zero when \(x = {{CT:1}}\), then one of the factors is \(\left({{CT:3}}\right)\), which is of course zero when \(x = {{CT:1}}\). The polynomial factorises as \[\begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle {{CT:0}}&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:4}}\mbox{,}\\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:5}}\mbox{,}\\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:6}}\mbox{,}\\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:7}}. \end{array}\] Matching coefficients \[\begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle {{CT:1}} + m + n&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:8}}\mbox{,}\\ {{CT:9}}+ {{CT:10}} + {{CT:11}}&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:12}}\mbox{,}\\ {{CT:13}}&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:14}}. \end{array}\] So \[m = {{CT:15}} - n\mbox{,}\] and \[ {{CT:11}} = {{CT:16}}\mbox{.} \] Substituting for \(m\) in terms of \(n\) \[\displaystyle {{CT:17}}\displaystyle =\displaystyle {{CT:16}}\mbox{.}\] This can be rearranged as \[{{CT:18}}\displaystyle =\displaystyle 0\mbox{.}\] Factorising \[{{CT:19}} = 0\mbox{,}\] and either \(n = {{CT:20}}\) and so \(m = {{CT:21}}\) or \(n = {{CT:21}}\) and \(m = {{CT:20}}\). The polynomial {{CT:2}} factorises as \[{{CT:22}}\mbox{.}\]
